provenance.disclaimer: Controlled synthetic benchmark fixture for evaluating graph-based neighbor aggregation. The 3.5% fraud prevalence reflects real-world class imbalance, but does NOT represent live banking fraud distributions or empirical records.

evaluation_protocol.threshold_selection_protocol: Validation-only grid search over 100 thresholds between 0.01 and 0.99. Optimal F1 threshold chosen to maximize binary F1 on validation predictions. Target recall threshold chosen as highest threshold with validation recall >= target_recall. Thresholds are frozen prior to test set evaluation.
evaluation_protocol.preprocessing_protocol: StandardScaler fitted strictly on training partition features (X_train). Validation and test sets transformed using training statistics. Zero transductive feature leakage.
